ui.updates.disk_image.heading.role: Update refusal panel shown when the app was opened straight from the mounted installer disk image (DMG) instead of from Applications
ui.updates.disk_image.heading.tone: Calm and factual, no blame and no exclamation; says what did not happen, then the one step the reader can take. Product name Local Operator stays verbatim; Applications is the macOS folder name (use the localized Finder name where macOS localizes it).
ui.updates.disk_image.heading.length: Short: a heading or button label.
